page.layout: One printed page, a title page, with lines centred in one column. Below the lines is a woodcut emblem, described in notes only. The lines are partly cut off at the edges and the text is mirrored in places.; One fragment of a printed page at the left edge: a few large letters running vertically (rotated), in the left margin area. No running text is visible.
page.notes: The emblem below the lines is a woodcut of a rounded ornamental shape with scrolls, not text. Many lines are cut off at the right edge, and some letters are mirrored from show-through, so the readings marked [?] are uncertain. The last line is a doubtful reading. The visible letters are rotated sideways and fragmentary: "IOA" and "NI" at upper left, "PRI" in the middle, and "CH" lower down. They look like parts of a vertically set running head or side title, and they are read here as printed. "IOA" and "NI" may be parts of one word split across two lines, and "PRI" and "CH" are uncertain. No readable running text, page number or catchword is visible.
